errors.evidence: The blue line starts exactly on the 340 grid line in 2018, not at approximately 335.

errors.text_span: Оранжевата линия започва при стойност около 120 и показва леко растеж до около 125 към 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The orange line starts at a value of approximately 125 in 2018, not 120. It remains relatively flat for the entire period, ending at a similar value (around 125-128). Describing it as starting at 120 and growing to 125 is incorrect.
The phrase "сиво-сив" is a redundant repetition meaning "grey-grey". The standard term is just "сива" (grey).

errors.text_span: Сивата линия започва при стойност около 165
errors.evidence: The grey line starts exactly on the 160 grid line in 2018, not at approximately 165.
The grey line does dip in 2020, but its value remains above the 160 line (at approximately 163). A value of 155 is significantly lower than what is shown in the chart.
